paragraphs: Yonatan: Rabbi Yitzchak and Rabbah were Yonatan’s sons. [Glosses: Yonatan. (1) Gittin 66a: ‘Rabbi Chanina said: Yonatan my son taught me that they have a shadow.’ It should read ‘Yonatan the demon,’ as in Yevamot 122a. It was not corrected. (2) Shabbat 49a, end: Rabbi Yonatan ben Akhnai; in several places, Akhmai. It was not corrected. (3) Avodah Zarah 36b: Rabbi Natan ben Amram; it should read Rabbi Yonatan. It was not corrected.]
